entities.lists.how: model entity lists in Plan/entities/, one per document

entities.readings.how: entity lists whose cited lines hold 90%+ of their rows

entities.rows.how: rows across all entity lists, cited or not

entities.rows_verified.how: entity rows whose cited file line contains the entity

graph.edges.how: typed edges in scripts/graph.py, each carrying the file line that states it

graph.evidence.how: quotations on term pages, the unit scripts/graphrag.py serves

graph.evidence_verified.how: of those, verified against their line by quotes.verdict

graph.nodes.how: nodes in scripts/graph.py's typed graph — terms, documents, conflicts, questions

graphrag.cases.how: retrieval cases the wiki labels itself: questions and conflicts

graphrag.recall_ppr.how: graphrag bench mean recall@8 in whole percent, personalized PageRank

graphrag.recall_seeds.how: graphrag bench mean recall@8 in whole percent, seeds alone — the floor

judgements.disagree.how: judgements where code now contradicts the record

judgements.mechanised.how: judgements a rule now claims and still agrees with

order.holds.how: scripts/account.py order — the pipeline's dependency order

pairs.fold_correct.how: of those, decided correctly by fold() — the floor

pairs.labelled.how: labelled one-term-or-two pairs derived from the judgement ledger

pairs.plural_correct.how: of those, decided correctly by the plural rule of decision 010 — the floor a model must beat

proposals.entities.how: entities from entity lists that verify as readings, graph.proposals()

proposals.entities_paged.how: of those, entities whose fold is a wiki page surface

proposals.glosses.how: stated `A (B)` glosses in 2+ documents routing to exactly one page

quotes.checked.how: cited quotations verified against their line

quotes.unchecked.how: quotations with no citation on their own line

quotes.unresolved.how: cited quotations that do not resolve, scripts/quotes.py

readme.decisions_drift.how: Plan/decisions/README.md against the decision files: missed plus dangling

readme.plan_drift.how: Plan/README.md against the folders in Plan/: missed plus dangling

readme.scripts_drift.how: scripts/README.md against the files in scripts/: missed plus dangling

readme.skills_drift.how: .agents/skills/README.md against the project skills: missed plus dangling

rules.count.how: modules in scripts/rules/ satisfying the contract

sources.canon_era.how: manifest rows with an index_date from 2026-05-01 on — the canon-era documents

sources.canon_era_landed.how: of those, rows landed in Sources/drive/

sources.distinct.how: landed files minus near-copies, scripts/duplicates.py at 0.8

sources.folded.how: rows in Sources/duplicates.jsonl — fetched, then found to be a copy

sources.landed.how: manifest rows carrying an export_path — the files on disk

sources.near_copies.how: landed files that are a near-copy of another

sources.repeated_titles.how: titles on more than one manifest row — a shared title is not a copy

sources.without_frontmatter.how: landed files that do not open with the eight lines of provenance

sweep.decided.how: sweep hits recorded in Plan/runs/sweep.jsonl as a reading or an occurrence

sweep.open.how: sweep hits in read documents that no reading and no ledger row settles — decision 012

sweep.readings.how: of those, readings the lookup had missed, now on their pages

trainset.fold_baseline_pct.how: what fold() scores on them — beat this or do not call an LM

trainset.surface_pairs.how: labelled one-term/two-terms examples in the ledger

wiki.conflicts.how: conflict records counted by the derived Wiki/index.json

wiki.open_statements.how: statements under an Open heading, the question harvest

wiki.orphans.how: pages nothing links to — the relation layer's gap

wiki.pages.how: pages counted by the derived Wiki/index.json

wiki.questions.how: question pages in Wiki/questions/, excluding the README

wiki.relations.how: a page naming another page as `slug`, scripts/relations.py

wiki.unmarked.how: a page's term written in another page's prose without being marked a link

wiki.zero_readings.how: term pages whose frontmatter says readings: 0 — a term only asked about
